item: The mind-map's tree-view button is keyed Mind-map, not the geographic Map (Lane J follow-up, Lane T)
summary: The Map | Cloud | Concept toggle above Explore's mind-map used the key Map, which is also the geographic Map subtabs' label, so zh showed 地图 (a map of places) and de/fr/ru/es read Karte/Carte/Карта/Mapa. The button now uses the existing Mind-map key, as the Analysis tab's own mm-views toggle already does: 思维导图, Mindmap, Carte mentale. No new string; locales stay 100%; a test refuses t("Map") in the mind-map controls.
